chapter_title: [Concerning the Advent of Five Fathers from the Five Limbs of the Father]
chapter_note: A very short chapter with a clear hagiographic/dialogue frame opening, followed by a compact core correspondential teaching: a fivefold emanation/advent sequence mapping five cosmic figures to five internal faculties/limbs of the Father (mind, thought, insight, counsel, consideration). No NT citation formulae; “Jesus the Beloved” functions here as a named cosmological being within the system, not as a Gospel overlay.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic editorial opening (“Once again the apostle speaks… He speaks thus:”), marking the dialogue/hagiographic frame; “apostle” is a compilation-layer attribution rather than substrate teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: The [Ambas]sador [came] from his mind; the Beloved of the Lights [from his thought]; the Mother of Life from his insight; [Jesus] the Beloved from his counsel; the Virgin of Lig[ht f]rom his consideration.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic fivefold correspondential mapping wholly within the cosmic architecture (emanated beings ↔ internal faculties/limbs of the Father). No institutional application or citation; impersonal structural voice.

paragraphs.core_text: So in this way were summone[d these five] fathers. These five advents came from the five limbs [of the Father]. One came from another and was manifested in its season.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the same structural exposition: fivefold advents from five limbs, sequential manifestation “in its season” (process description, not exhortation or polemic).
